overrides.note: 'Severity coverage' is a defined contract term, not a claim about the stop gate. deep-review/assets/review-mode-contract.yaml:69-92 sets requiredForSeverityCoverage true only for correctness and security. It sets it false for traceability, maintainability and customDimensionRule, yet traceability and maintainability also block all_dimensions_clean. The only code that reads the flag is render-contract-snapshot.cjs:301. So the yaml:2645 row is true under the contract and matches custom-review-dimensions.md:16 and feature-catalog.md:440. It does not say custom dimensions are optional for the stop, so it does not mislead a reader into a wrong stop. The real gap is that the row leaves out that the custom dimension still gates the clean stop (convergence.cjs:1599-1614, :1127-1132). That is a clarity follow-up, so P2.
